villagelife.configuration.title: Village Life Settings
How far a village reaches around its center.
villagelife.configuration.maxResidentsPe: No more residents move in once this number is reached.
villagelife.configuration.tickBudgetMicr: Higher values finish background work faster but can cost server performance.
villagelife.configuration.showBuildingOu: Shows the borders of registered buildings while holding a building marker.
villagelife.village.too_close: Too close to the village "%s" – villages must not overlap.
villagelife.village.none_here: You are not inside a village.
villagelife.building.valid: %s registered in "%s": %s blocks of space, %s door(s), %s bed(s), %s storage container(s), %s work station(s).
villagelife.building.problem.not_in_vill: %s not registered – the marker is not inside a village.
villagelife.building.problem.not_yours: Only the owner and the managers of "%s" may mark buildings here.
villagelife.building.problem.no_roof: the roof is missing (the sky is visible from inside).
villagelife.building.problem.not_enclose: the room is not closed or larger than %s blocks.
villagelife.building.problem.unloaded: the room reaches into an unloaded area.
villagelife.building.problem.already_reg: This building already has a building marker – break the old one, then the new one counts.
villagelife.building.problem.too_small: the room is too small (at least %s blocks of space).
villagelife.building.problem.area_open: no closed fence found (or the area is larger than %s blocks). Fences, walls, gates and hedges count as border.
villagelife.building.problem.area_too_sm: the area is too small (at least %s blocks).
villagelife.building.problem.no_containe: a chest or barrel is missing (at least %s).
villagelife.building.problem.no_workstat: a work station is missing (at least %s, e.g. crafting table or furnace).
villagelife.configuration.maxBuildingVol: Larger or open rooms are not accepted as buildings.
villagelife.configuration.buildingRescan: How often every building is checked again. Changes by players are checked right away.
villagelife.configuration.aiThinkInterva: How often residents decide what to do. 20 ticks = 1 second. Higher values save server time.
villagelife.resident.arrived: %s has arrived in %s and moved into a free bed.
villagelife.village.info.beds: Beds: %s free of %s; residents without a bed: %s
villagelife.debug.immigrate.none: Nobody moved in (no free bed, village full, or village center not loaded).
villagelife.configuration.immigrationInt: Minimum time between two new residents in one village. 2400 ticks = 2 minutes. Newcomers only come if beds are free.
villagelife.village.info.jobs: Workplaces: %s, of which %s taken; residents without a job: %s
villagelife.configuration.foodPerDay.too: How many food points (of 20) a resident loses per Minecraft day. 0 = residents never get hungry.
villagelife.book.title: Village Window
villagelife.book.no_village.title: No village
villagelife.book.no_village: You are not standing in a village and do not own one yet. Place a village center to found a village, or walk into a village to look at it.
villagelife.book.overview.intro: Everything about this village at a glance.
villagelife.book.overview.no_loaded: Satisfaction appears when residents are nearby.
villagelife.book.residents.intro: Everybody who lives here. Click a name to open the resident's page.
villagelife.book.residents.legend: Bed: has a bed · Sleep: slept in it last night · ● mood (green happy, orange content, red unhappy). Live values only for residents nearby.
villagelife.book.resident.not_loaded: Live values appear when this resident is nearby.
villagelife.book.buildings.intro: All buildings of the village. Click a building (or right-click its marker) for its page.
villagelife.book.buildings.none: No buildings yet. Place a building marker inside a room.
villagelife.problem.starving: %s resident(s) are starving and work at half speed
villagelife.problem.starving.tip: Put food (bread, carrots, potatoes …) into a storage building.
villagelife.problem.homeless.tip: Build a house with beds and place a marker set to "House".
villagelife.problem.no_storage.tip: Build a room with a chest and set its marker to "Storage".
villagelife.problem.no_food.tip: Hungry residents get their food from the storage – add some.
villagelife.problem.storage_full.tip: Add chests to a storage building or empty them.
villagelife.problem.hungry.tip: They will look for food in the storage.
villagelife.problem.unhappy.tip: Food, beds and a good night's sleep make residents happy. Unhappy villages get no newcomers.
villagelife.problem.invalid_building.tip: See the "Buildings" area for the reason.
villagelife.problem.workplace_without_ch: Workers then bring everything to the storage – a chest in the workplace saves them the walk.
villagelife.problem.work.fisherman.no_wa: He needs open water (at least 8 water blocks) with a free bank, at most 16 blocks from his hut.
villagelife.problem.no_beds.tip: Newcomers only arrive when there are free beds.
villagelife.problem.unemployed.tip: Build a workplace: crafting table = lumberjack, composter = farmer, barrel = fisherman, loom = shepherd, hay bale = breeder, stonecutter = miner, smoker = cook, smithing table = smith, furnace = baker, fletching table = carpenter, lectern = storekeeper, cartography table = merchant.
villagelife.book.settings.intro_owner: Click a value to change it. Changes apply at once.
villagelife.book.settings.intro_guest: Only the owner and his managers can change these settings.
villagelife.book.settings.name: Name
villagelife.book.settings.hours_info: Residents work from start to end of work, have free time until 21:00 and then sleep.
villagelife.book.settings.food_reserve_i: Warn in "Problems" when the storage holds less food than this.
villagelife.problem.low_food: Little food in the storage (%s of %s)
villagelife.problem.low_food.tip: Below your food reserve – the farmer and some bread help.
villagelife.configuration.showMinimap.to: Small map in the top right corner. Toggle in game with the minimap key (default N).
villagelife.book.map.village_hint: Right click: set a waypoint. Areas you have not loaded yet stay blank.
villagelife.book.map.area_hint: Click: move the view. Right click: set a waypoint.
villagelife.book.map.zone_first: Click the first corner of the zone.
villagelife.book.markers.no_waypoints: No waypoints yet. Set one on the map (right click or "Waypoint here").
villagelife.book.markers.no_zones: This village has no zones yet.
villagelife.book.markers.no_zones_owner: No zones yet. Draw one on the map in the village view.
villagelife.book.markers.zones_no_villag: Zones belong to a village. Stand in a village or found one.
villagelife.marker.name: Name
villagelife.waypoint.limit: You already have %s waypoints – delete one first.
villagelife.configuration.maxWaypointsPe: How many waypoints one player may have (all dimensions together).
villagelife.configuration.maxZonesPerVil: How many named zones one village may have.
villagelife.book.map.claim_hint: Click: claim or free a chunk. Right click: waypoint.
villagelife.claim.protected: Claimed by %s – you cannot build here.
villagelife.claim.result.taken: This chunk already belongs to someone else.
villagelife.claim.result.foreign_village: Inside another player's village only the village owner can claim chunks.
villagelife.claim.result.limit: You have no claims left (limit reached).
villagelife.claim.result.too_far: Too far away – outside your village only up to 64 chunks away.
villagelife.configuration.claimsPerPlaye: How many chunks every player may claim anywhere (per dimension).
villagelife.configuration.claimsInOwnVil: How many extra chunks a player may claim inside his own villages.
villagelife.book.friends.none: No friends yet. Invite someone who is online on the right page.
villagelife.book.friends.invite_hint: Click a player who is online now. He has to accept the invitation.
villagelife.book.friends.nobody_online: Nobody you could invite is online right now.
villagelife.friend.invited_you: %s wants to be your friend – open the village window (B) → Player → Friends.
villagelife.configuration.maxFriends.too: How many friends one player may have.
villagelife.book.settings.intro_manager: You are a manager: click a value to change it. Only the owner can rename the village.
villagelife.book.settings.managers_info: Managers may change settings, draw zones and claim chunks of the village (for the owner). They can open the village window from anywhere.
villagelife.book.settings.no_friends: You have no friends yet. Invite someone in the "Player" area.
villagelife.claim.center_protected: This village center belongs to %s – only the owner can break it.
villagelife.book.character.no_villages: You do not own or manage a village yet. Place a village center to found one.
villagelife.book.building.field_tip: The farmers work all farmland inside the fence.
villagelife.book.building.pasture_tip: Shepherds and breeders without a work area of their own tend their animals on the nearest pasture.
villagelife.book.building.not_loaded: The building is not loaded right now – move closer.
villagelife.debug.perf.header: Mod performance (average of the last 5 s) – active residents: %s, %s µs per resident
villagelife.debug.perf.total: Mod total: avg %s µs/tick | server tick avg %s ms | mod share: %s %% (target: below 2000 µs with 100 residents)
villagelife.debug.testvillage.done: Test village built: %s buildings registered (6 houses with 2 beds each, dormitory with 100 beds, storage with bread, lumberjack with forest, farm with field). Fill it with "/villagelife debug spawnresident 50" (twice).
villagelife.debug.perf.paths: of which path searches: avg %s µs/tick, max %s µs (%s paths per tick, %s µs per path; %s per tick postponed)
villagelife.configuration.pathSearchesPe: How many new paths all residents together may search per tick. Lower = smoother server at sunrise and bedtime.
villagelife.book.profession.work_area: Assign a work area on the map
villagelife.book.profession.no_workplace: None yet – the left page shows how to build one.
villagelife.profession.lumberjack.tip: Fells trees around the hut and replants them.
villagelife.profession.farmer.tip: Harvests ripe fields around the farm and sows again.
villagelife.profession.fisherman.tip: Needs open water (at least 8 blocks) with a free bank.
villagelife.profession.shepherd.tip: Shears, breeds and keeps the herd in his work area at the limit.
villagelife.problem.work.no_work_area.ti: Herders: put a building marker set to "Pasture" into a fenced pasture. Otherwise draw a zone on the map and choose it as work area on the building page.
villagelife.book.building.work_area.draw: Draw a zone on the map first.
villagelife.profession.breeder.tip: Looks after cows, pigs and chickens in his work area: eggs, milk (with buckets), meat and leather.
villagelife.profession.miner.tip: Digs a pit with stairs along the edge in his work area. A fence around it keeps others from falling in.
Assign a new zone, make it bigger or set a deeper pit in the settings.
villagelife.profession.cook.tip: Cooks raw meat, fish and potatoes from storage in the smoker. Needs coal or wood.
villagelife.problem.work.cook.no_fuel.ti: Put coal, charcoal, logs or planks into storage – the miner and the lumberjack deliver them.
villagelife.problem.work.cook.no_food: Cook %s (workplace at %s) has nothing to cook
villagelife.problem.work.cook.no_food.ti: Put raw meat, raw fish or potatoes into storage – the breeder, fisherman and farmer deliver them.
villagelife.problem.work.farmer.no_field: Put a building marker set to "Field" into a fenced field. Without field markers the farmer looks for farmland at most 12 blocks around the farm (at most 6 blocks higher or lower, under open sky).
villagelife.problem.work.farmer.no_seeds: Put wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes or beetroot seeds into storage or into the farm's chest.
villagelife.profession.smith.tip: Smelts raw iron in the blast furnace and forges better tools for the professions – they go to storage.
villagelife.problem.work.smith.no_fuel.t: Put coal, charcoal, logs or planks into storage.
villagelife.profession.baker.tip: Bakes bread, cookies and pumpkin pie from ingredients in storage – until there is enough in storage.
villagelife.problem.work.no_material.tip: The profession page shows under "Needs" what has to go into storage.
villagelife.profession.carpenter.tip: Turns logs into planks and sticks, planks into chests, and with white wool into beds.
villagelife.profession.storekeeper.tip: Brings goods from the workplaces' chests to storage and supplies the workplaces with material. Only workplaces with a chest.
villagelife.profession.merchant.tip: Stands at the market during the day. While he is there, you trade in the village window under "Economy & trade → Market" – with emeralds.
villagelife.book.market.status.no_market: No market yet: build a workplace with a cartography table.
villagelife.book.market.status.no_mercha: The merchant is not at the market right now.
villagelife.book.market.status.too_far: Go to the market (at %s) to trade.
villagelife.book.market.nothing_wanted: The village needs nothing right now.
villagelife.book.market.need_items: You need %s of these – you have %s.
villagelife.book.market.caravan_here: A caravan is in the village right now.
villagelife.book.market.caravan_morning: The next one comes next morning.

villagelife.caravan.no_deals: A trading caravan visited %s but found nothing to trade.
villagelife.debug.caravan.done: A caravan is on its way to the market.
villagelife.debug.caravan.none: No caravan possible: no market, one is already there or no free spot nearby.

villagelife.contract.countered: %s made a counter offer – village window → Economy & trade → Contracts.
villagelife.contract.cancelled: %s cancelled the trade contract (ends in 1 day).
villagelife.contract.problem.partner: That village no longer exists or has no market.

villagelife.contract.problem.not_your_tu: It is the other village's turn.

villagelife.book.contracts.road_out: ↗ %s %s on the way to the partner – arrives %s
villagelife.contract.skipped: %s has no surplus of %s right now – the delivery to %s is skipped (%s of %s failures).
villagelife.contract.underpaid: %s could only pay %s of %s × %s – debt now: %s (%s of %s failures).
villagelife.debug.contracts.done: %s deliveries made due – they start within 10 seconds.
villagelife.book.contracts.paused: ⏸ Paused: a village has no market with a merchant right now.

villagelife.book.growth.below: ⚠ The village no longer meets the requirements of its stage. The stage stays – but look after your residents!
villagelife.book.growth.top_info: Your town has reached the highest stage. Congratulations!
villagelife.book.growth.parcel_hint: Rising brings a celebration and a supply parcel for the storage.
villagelife.book.growth.unknown: Satisfaction is only known while residents are nearby.
villagelife.growth.bonus: Now allowed: up to %s residents, village radius %s blocks, %s trade contracts.
villagelife.growth.bonus_no_radius: Now allowed: up to %1$s residents, %3$s trade contracts – the radius (%2$s blocks) could not grow, another village is in the way.
villagelife.growth.parcel: 📦 Mail has arrived: a supply parcel is in the storage.
villagelife.growth.parcel_center: 📦 Mail has arrived: the storage was too full – the rest of the parcel lies at the village center.
villagelife.debug.stage.top: The village already has the highest stage.
villagelife.book.resident.no_friends: Hasn't really got to know anyone yet.
villagelife.profession.innkeeper.tip: Brings food from storage to the tavern (chest next to the brewing stand). In the evening everyone meets there, eats and gets sociable: +5 mood until morning.
villagelife.debug.couple.none: There are no two single adults in this village.
villagelife.family.grown_up: %s is grown up now and looks for a job.
villagelife.debug.baby.none: There is no couple in this village yet.
villagelife.profession.teacher.tip: Teaches the children at the school's bookshelf in the morning. Every lesson gives education – educated adults work up to 20 % faster.
villagelife.book.management.priorities_i: Professions at the top get workers first. Every morning a resident of a lower profession moves up if a place higher up is free.
villagelife.book.management.priorities_g: Professions at the top get workers first. Only the owner and managers can change the order.
villagelife.book.management.essential: Basic profession – every new village needs it
villagelife.book.management.notification: What you are told about in chat. Only for you, in all villages you manage.
Only the owner and managers get messages.
villagelife.book.laws.info: Click to change. New laws apply from the next morning.
villagelife.book.laws.guest: Only the owner and managers can change laws.
villagelife.book.laws.rest_day.bad: − no work on the rest day
villagelife.book.laws.curfew.good: + safe at home in the evening
villagelife.profession.guard.tip: Patrols the village by day and fights monsters with a sword – also at night when they come into the village. Fetches a better sword and armor from storage.
villagelife.profession.archer.tip: Shoots monsters with arrows from storage. Without arrows he fights close up. Put arrows into storage!
villagelife.profession.captain.tip: Fights with a sword and makes guards and archers near him (16 blocks) a quarter stronger.
villagelife.problem.work.archer.no_arrow: Put arrows into a storage chest – the archer fetches them.
villagelife.defense.knocked_out: 🛡 %s was knocked out in a fight and rests in the guardhouse until tomorrow morning.
villagelife.defense.attack: ⚔ Bandits attack %s! (%s bandits) The bells ring – everybody goes home.
villagelife.defense.won: 🛡 %s fought off the attack! The loot is in the storage, the village celebrates (+5 mood until tomorrow).
villagelife.defense.plundered: %s: %s bandits got away with %s stolen items, %s were beaten.
villagelife.defense.alarm_on: 🔔 Alarm! All residents go home for 2 hours.
villagelife.defense.alarm_off: 🔔 All clear – the residents go about their day again.
villagelife.debug.attack.failed: No attack possible (already running, or the village border is not loaded).

villagelife.convoy.ambush: ⚔ Bandits are attacking the trade wagon of %s!
villagelife.convoy.defended: 🛡 The shipment from %s to %s was attacked – the escort drove the bandits off!
villagelife.convoy.raided: ⚠ Bandits raided the shipment from %s to %s and took %s of %s %s. The contract goes on.
villagelife.debug.convoy.done: %s shipments on the road will be raided in about 70 seconds. Stand by the road to the partner village!
villagelife.book.contracts.road_waiting: %s × %s wait at the gate – the storage is full

villagelife.configuration.starterKit.too: Every player gets a village center and 5 building markers once per world on first join.
villagelife.starter_kit.given: Welcome! You received a village center and %s building markers. Place the village center to found your village.
villagelife.hint.plain_bell: A normal bell does not found a village – craft a village center instead
